One who performs daring gymnastic feats
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

• The word **"Acrobat"** refers to a person who performs daring gymnastic feats, typically involving balancing, jumping, and other physical activities. (कलाबाज)

 
 
• **Example: **The acrobat amazed the audience with his stunning somersaults and tightrope walking.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Addict **(आदी): A person who is addicted to a particular substance, typically an illegal drug.

 
 
• **Example:** He is an addict who needs professional help to overcome his addiction.
 
 
 
• **Adonis **(सुंदर पुरुष ): A very handsome young man.
 
 
• **Example: **He was often compared to an Adonis because of his striking good looks.
 
 
 
• **Advocate** (वकील): A person who publicly supports or recommends a particular cause or policy.
 
 
• **Example:** She is a strong advocate for women's rights.
